models_evaluated: Commercial deep learning-based CAD for pneumothorax with electronic notification system

links.outcome: Time to treatment for pneumothorax, CAD plus electronic notification vs CAD-only
links.effect: TTT for oxygen reduced -143.8 min (95% CI -277.8 to -9.9; P=.035); no significant difference for aspiration/tube thoracostomy (14.4 min) or thoracic surgery consultation (86.3 min).
links.quote: There was a significant reduction in TTT for supplemental oxygen therapy for the CAD and ENS group compared with the CAD-only group in the postimplementation period (-143.8 min; 95% confidence interval [CI], -277.8 to -9.9; P = .035).

unlisted_practices: Simultaneous electronic notification of AI-detected critical findings to both the radiologist and the referring clinician
